title: fix(cli): a --role after -- overrides the dispatch role (1.52.0 regression)
description:
## .what
rhachet 1.52.0 reads a `--role` that follows `--` as the dispatch role.

## .repro
```
rhx review.by --repo bhrain --role reviewer -- --role ghost
```
- 1.51.0: dispatches to bhrain/reviewer/review.by, which receives `--role ghost` (correct)
- 1.52.0: `no skill \"review.by\" found with --repo bhrain --role ghost`

## .why it matters
`--` must end rhachet dispatch flags; every role wrapper that forwards a target `--role` breaks.

## .ask
stop the dispatch arg parse at `--`; add a clamp test.
